 "architecture": "TypeScript on Bun, built on the kit wrapper: one brain file (about 700 lines), a line-of-sight map module, a ground A* module and a six-knob parameter file. Deterministic, no randomness, no state machine object; each decision walks a fixed if/else priority chain for movement, then a separate aim/fire block.\n\nMovement priority, highest first:\n1. Outside the zone: path to the current centre, boosting.\n2. Just-in-time trip to the next circle.\n3. Retreat to a nearby spot out of the attackers' sight (HP under 35% and hit in the last 2 s).\n4. Same trigger with no such spot: back away from the hit bearing, leaning toward the centre near the zone edge.\n5. Heal mode (HP under 90%): stand still, or creep to a hidden spot if seen.\n6. Walk to a wanted weapon.\n7. Stand in a supply-drop ring.\n8. Walk to a cube or landed drop.\n9. Slip out of enemy sight cones.\n10. Default: stand still.\n\nOther structure: enemy memory map kept 30 s (position, velocity, HP history, weapons), but stored HP and the \"aggression\" knob are never read. Setup can never throw (falls back to a walk-to-centre, shoot-nearest bot). A path search only starts if under 20 ms of the tick is used, and LOS checks go to the nearest 8 enemies only.\n\nA written rulebook plans much more (TTK-ratio engage gate, dodge reflexes, third-partying, sound tracking, drop contest rules), but none of that was implemented.\n\nLocal clone: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-yang-mills-workbench/c2b3cfae-3f5d-5b6f-8fe6-a6e757d1bb60/scratchpad/mechbot/intel/dmclaughlin-bit__mech-bot. Most valuable files there: EXPERIMENTS.md, coord/log.md, coord/learnings.md, pipeline/data/evidence.jsonl, research/intake/diego-match-data-1129.md, AI-Structure-Development.md (rulebook in section 9).",
 "navigation": "Ground-only A* on a 2 m cell grid derived from the 1 m terrain.\n- Blocking: building prisms block unless low enough to step on or high enough to walk under; bridge decks become walkable surface; walls are grown by 2 m; any 1 m vertex whose neighbour differs by more than the step height is blocked both ways (no planned drops).\n- Search: 8-connected, no corner cutting, integer costs (10 straight, 14 diagonal, plus 4 per metre climbed), octile heuristic weighted 1.1, typed-array heap, generation stamps, connected-component labels so cross-component queries fail instantly. Endpoints snap to a free cell within 10 cells. Waypoints are string-pulled with a conservative supercover test.\n- Use: budget 20,000 expansions per in-tick query; replan at most once a second or when the goal moves more than 10 m; waypoint reached at 4 m.\n- Stuck handling: 0.5 s of commanded movement at under 15% of walk speed triggers a jump (or boost if already airborne) and drops the route.\n- No roofs and no jets; jump only when stuck. Weapon-loot and hide moves use straight-line headings, not paths.\n- Measured: grid build 90-110 ms; median query 0.33-0.36 ms, p99 6-8 ms at a 30,000 budget; 72% of cells walkable, the largest component holds 94% of them.",
 "aiming_and_fire_control": "Target choice: the nearest enemy with a clear muzzle line, otherwise the nearest known; never the lowest HP.\n\nGun:\n- Lead is a closed-form constant-velocity intercept on horizontal velocity only, flight time capped at 3 s.\n- Fires only when the torso is within a tolerance sized to 1.2 times the target radius (yaw) and half its height (pitch) at that range.\n- Gate: fires only inside 100 m, unless the target hit us in the last 2 s, is under 50% HP, or its sideways speed does not exceed its radial speed.\n- Reload: when the magazine is empty; when no target is known, top up below half a magazine.\n\nLaser: steers the aim whenever it is off cooldown, has a clear line and is within its range (no shorter range gate). Holds fire to charge and releases only at full charge with the torso on target.\n\nLightning: fires whenever the target is in range, inside the cone around the current aim, and energy covers one shot.\n\nMortar: never picked up; leftover lob code picks the high arc when the line is blocked.\n\nAim priority per tick: laser, then lightning, then gun, then mortar. With no target the torso faces the last hit bearing for 2 s, otherwise the travel direction. LOS checks use buildings and terrain only; trees are ignored for both shooting and sight.",
 "survival_and_anti_squad_tactics": "Nothing squad-specific was implemented beyond generic retreat, hide and heal.\n- Retreat: HP under 35% and hit within 2 s. Samples 12 bearings at the distances walked in 1, 2 and 3 s and takes the first spot that is straight-line reachable, inside the zone, not closer to any threat, and unseen by the nearest 8 enemies. Torso stays on the attacker; boost only above 30% energy. With no such spot, backs away from the hit bearing.\n- Heal mode: HP under 90%. Stands still, or creeps under 5 m/s to an unseen spot, while continuing to shoot normally.\n- Sight-cone evasion while idle: steps out of any enemy's 45 m ring and 120-degree wedge, using the enemy's observed aim.\n- Silent movement (under 5 m/s) once inside the next circle.\n- No kiting, no peek-and-cover, no deliberate regen cycle (firing keeps resetting the regen timer), no special handling of the first lone hunter, no late-game plan.\n\nTheir own unbuilt analysis is the useful part:\n- In practice each kill is roughly one point and outlasting earns only zone deaths, so the first lone, weakest-tier hunter should be fought and killed, not fled from.\n- Proposed rules: skip the low-HP retreat while exactly one enemy is known and time-to-kill beats time-to-die; always finish a target within one magazine (540 damage) or one laser shot (315) when no second enemy has a line to us; walk to the death drop; heal to full between hunters.\n- Arithmetic behind it: at the 35% retreat line (490 HP) the bot dies to 11 gun hits (about 2.6 s) while backing away, so many retreats give up nearly won fights.",
 "loot_weapons_upgrades": "Weapons: wants laser and lightning only, never a mortar. Loots only when no enemy is within 160 m and the pickup is within 80 m. Keeps the gun until the second special weapon appears, then swaps the gun out, never with an enemy in view.\n\nUpgrade order: plating, armor, nanites, sensors, then any weapon-prefixed upgrade or gyros, then mobility (servos, jets, capacitor, reactor). It does not check which weapons are held.\n\nFarming (last build): only in the zone, not while leaving for the next circle, no enemy in view, none remembered within 160 m in the last 10 s, and no non-drone damage for 3 s.\n- Shoots the nearest clear drone or crate within 100 m; drone return fire does not cancel farming.\n- Walks by path to visible cubes and landed, unheld supply drops within 80 m, only if the item is inside the current circle and the next circle is still reachable with the 10 s buffer.\n- Stands 1.5 m inside the drop ring to capture.\n- Abandons an item chased for 15 s (roof items).\n- No cube cap and no drop pre-positioning.\n\nWhat Top-16 exhibition winners did (7 recorded free-for-all wins: Mustikas twice, AT twice, BackwardsDeployeds, TigerTown27, \"404 Competition Not Found\"):\n- Final loadout: 6 of 7 laser plus lightning, 1 gun plus laser.\n- Upgrades across the 43 picks: plating 8, armor 8, laser damage 7, capacitor 4, nanites 3, servos 3, laser charge 3, sensors 2, one each of gyros, gun magazine, gun damage, lightning efficiency, lightning range.\n- Max cubes 15-35 (mean about 26); first cube at a median 11 s.\n- Crates opened 1-3; drones killed 0-4; supply drops 0-3 (mean 1.0, against 0.1 for places 2-4).",
 "zone_and_endgame": "Holds wherever it stands until the last moment, then departs.\n- Departure test: path distance divided by 0.8 times walk speed, plus 10 s, plus 2 s per enemy known within 50 m of the route, reaches the time left to the end of the shrink.\n- Destination: the point where the straight line to the next centre crosses an inner ring (next radius minus the smaller of 15 m and 25% of the radius). So it parks just inside the edge.\n- Boosts only if walking cannot make it.\n- A path is planned only once twice the straight-line time plus buffers exceeds the time left; their own note says it leaves late where the real path is more than twice the straight line (around the stadium).\n- Outside the zone it boosts along a path to the current centre.\n- Hiding and farming are confined to the current circle, or to the next one once inside it.\n\nNo endgame logic: no final-centre cover, no HP stacking, no late-match rule.\n\nExhibition winners spent 0% of time outside the zone and sat at a mean 0.34-0.56 of the zone radius from the centre (mean 0.445).",

  "Use the optional commit field to A/B unmerged branches, one mechanism per submission, judged by raw delta because scoring is deterministic.",
  "Sight-cone evasion: use each enemy's observed torso aim to stay outside its 45 m ring and 120-degree wedge, and test candidate spots with eye-to-centre and eye-to-top rays.",
  "Gun fire gate based on the target's sideways versus radial speed, with overrides when the target is hitting us or is under half HP.",
  "Zone departure buffer that adds 2 s per enemy known within 50 m of the planned route.",
  "Zone-safety test for any detour: the item must be inside the current circle, and item-then-next-circle travel time plus buffer plus capture time must fit before the shrink ends.",
  "Farming rules: drone return fire does not cancel farming, a 15 s give-up timer blacklists unreachable (roof) items, and the capture stance is 1.5 m inside the drop ring.",
  "Proposed but unbuilt engage rule: fight a lone hunter while time-to-kill beats time-to-die, never retreat from a target within one magazine or one laser shot when no second shooter has a line, then collect its death drop.",
  "Evidence that cover matters at rest: winners almost never hold in the open. Their own failed cover build suggests moving to cover only while no enemy is visible.",
  "Stepping into a rival's supply-drop ring freezes their capture clock without resetting it.",
  "Per-tick safety budget: start a path search only if under 20 ms has elapsed, and limit LOS checks to the nearest 8 enemies."
